face_off: a confrontational standoff, subjects squared against each other across the frame
oppositional framing, the tension centered between two clusters
gathering: a wide group composition, subjects arranged loosely across the scene
an establishing wide shot, the whole gathering visible in its surroundings
candid_moment: a candid, unposed framing, subjects caught mid-action
an observer's framing, as if glimpsed rather than staged
atmospheric: the environment dominates the frame, figures small within it
an establishing shot where weather and place carry the scene
close_group: a tight group framing, subjects pressed close, faces and hands in focus
an intimate cluster, cropped close on the interaction
at_work: an observational framing, hands and tools in focus mid-task
a working shot, the task and its motion centered in frame
default: a wide shot with establishing details
a balanced composition, the full scene visible
a medium shot centered on the subject cluster
